== Build notes ==
* Dest of Michael Mikaelian, "Killer Decks II", ''InQuest'' #20 (December 1996), pp. 38–39. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-20 archive.org/details/inquest-20] (printed 38–39 = PDF leaves 19–20). IA item is a partial copy of the physical magazine; this spread is in the surviving middle.
* Printed 60 counted from the deck box. Substitutions sit outside the 60 and outside the GEMP file.
* Top 10 Light Side cards is the same spread. A printed [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] overlay covers part of items 5–7; those blurbs stay off the article.
* Format [[Premiere - A New Hope]] from the card pool. Newest printed set in the list is [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]].
